description: Issue #4038 sub-slice 9g: today's SafeSearch stage (pfblockerng_apply.inc, the block from 'Loading DNSBL SafeSearch' to the CSV write, then pfb_ss_csv()) against Core's (go/pfb_core/dnsbl SafeSearchTable). A case gives the policy/dnsbl SafeSearch fields, the four pfb_dnsbl.<name>.conf lists (text, 'shipped' for the package's own, absent for a missing file) and a fixture resolver for the CNAME targets that today's PHP asks (a target it does not name resolves to nothing): the host's resolver is never asked. Core resolves nothing (owner, 2026-11-23): a CNAME row carries its target only, and pfB-DNS resolves the fallback addresses itself, so a case whose CNAME rows today's PHP bakes addresses into keeps that CSV in old_expect. expect.csv is the decider's CSV of the rows; expect.refused the hosts Core leaves out, with an issue, because a row of theirs would not read back from that CSV as written (a comma in a field, or an empty host); old_expect.csv is today's CSV where Core departs. Frozen by tests/php/DnsblSafeSearchParityTest.php.

cases.description: Every SafeSearch switch off: no host, no table, though the files are there.

SafeSearch on with the shipped list: the A rewrites, and the two CNAME redirects with their targets resolved by the fixture resolver (pixabay's AAAA unresolved). Core leaves the CNAME rows' addresses to pfB-DNS (old_expect: today's baked addresses).
YouTube Strict with the shipped list: A and AAAA rewrites of one host merged into one row.
YouTube Moderate with the shipped list.
DoH blocking with the shipped list and two selected servers: a selected name matches every line it is a substring of; the rest are commented out.

Every switch on with the shipped lists; the resolver answers nothing for DuckDuckGo, so its rows carry no baked address. Core leaves the CNAME rows' addresses to pfB-DNS (old_expect: today's baked addresses).
DoH on with no server selected: every line is commented out, no host.
SafeSearch on, its list missing: file() reads nothing, no host.

How today's reader takes each line shape: www. stripped, a CNAME later given an A, nxdomain winning over a later A, lines without a quote or a space, double spaces, a blank line, a last line without a newline; a second file adds fields to hosts of the first (merge per field).
